The cable organizer is built and checked. It is 100 mm long, 45 mm deep and 43 mm tall, with five 12 mm wide cable slots at 18 mm pitch. The front plate and hook lip are sized for a desk top about 25 mm thick. It is in the project as "Desk cable organizer" and passes the plan check: it is watertight with 3 mm minimum walls.

The sizes you confirmed were length (100 mm) and slot count (5). The rest are my guesses, which you can change on the sheet or in Model:
- Tray depth 45 mm and height 15 mm
- Slot width 12 mm, depth 12 mm, pitch 18 mm
- Clip plate 5 mm thick, dropping 28 mm below the tray
- Hook lip 10 mm under the desk
- Desk top thickness 25 mm, which decides whether the hook fits your desk

As built, the tray underside overhangs the desk side by about 40 mm, so it will need supports or a different print orientation. I have not sent it to a printer. Tell me if you want me to orient it for printing, slice it on your P1S with PLA, and queue it for your approval.
